title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Government Debt & Infrastructure Finance - Madagascar

description.narrative: The goal of this project is to broaden the Government of Madagascar's financing options and reduce the risks of unpredictable foreign borrowing by improving the Ministry of Economy and Finance's (MEF) capacity to transparently issue and manage public debt in the primary market for local currency denominated government securities. Project activities will focus on 1) transitioning to market based auctions to improve transparency and reliability of funding and 2) enhancing the MEF's capacity to issue and manage the debt portfolio.
